text_block_list.text:
Craving some fried chicken, I visited a shop 
and spotted Satono Diamond and 
Kitasan Black inside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your offer, I'll leave the ordering to you, 
Kita-chan. Fufu, I can't wait♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't stare at me like that, damn it... 
If you want it that bad, just eat some, won't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! Shut up! 
I'm totally fine, okay?!

Inside the shop were Jungle Pocket and 
Tosen Jordan. 
They seemed to be bickering over something...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Pokke-san and Jordan-san? 
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys! This chick's going on about being on a diet 
and only drinking juice.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And then she stares at me while I'm eating like she's super 
jealous! But when I tell her to just have a bite if she wants it, 
she refuses!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not looking jealous at all! 
Not evvvven a tiny bit...!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It definitely is tempting when you're watching your weight, isn't it? 
Though pushing yourself too hard isn't good either... Hmm, 
if only there was a good way to handle this――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, Kita-chan! Why don't we try our usual thing? 
With that method, I'm sure it'll work!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
By that――you mean that one! 
Yeah, that sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Could you two wait for just a moment? 
We're going to order our food!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. 
Here we go――Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Here, halfsies♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dia-chan! 
All right――!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ――Itadakimasu!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, eating together really makes it so delicious! 
And it's only half the calories too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, exactly♪ ――So, 
was this helpful as a reference?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, that's awesome! 
Alright Jordan, eat half of mine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, but――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, 
I'll just rip off a chunk for now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Done! 
Keep your mouth open――ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ――Mmph!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!!!! 
So freakin' goooood~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Hell yeah, that's what I'm talking about!! 
Alright, my turn――!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So daaaamn goooood~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan, let's eat our chicken too! 
Itadakimasu♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah, that was so good...!! 
Wait, ugh... I totally ate it, seriously...?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just run it off, run it off!! 
Let's do a joint run once we get back!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real?! Uggghhh...

After a while, walking out of the shop―― 
I came across a rather bizarre scene.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, McQueen! Thou hast splendidly completed 
the domino toppling, and so I bestow a reward upon thee. Half and half.
choice_data_list: (W-What in the world is she wearing...!?)

text_block_list.text:
For some reason, she was wearing 
a costume that looked strangely familiar...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do any domino toppling, though... 
B-But, is it truly alright for me to have this...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, indeed. A humble comfort for thee who struggles with dieting. 
Now then, behold――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ――SPLIT IN HALF-SIESSSSSS!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For a split second, flashed before thine eyes, did it not? 
'Me splitting into port and starboard.' 
Fwahaha, rejoice, McQueen!
